notes: Suffix text for the 8 variants carried over from perturbations_v0 is unchanged. 'instructs' lists the metrics a suffix directly asks to change (instructed) or plausibly implies (adjacent); a deformation on an instructed metric is compliance, not evidence of deformation. stakes_neutral and stakes_retirement are a matched pair: neither says anything about reasoning structure. 'contrasts' lists extra (reference, target) pairs analyzed beyond baseline-vs-each.
